acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Samples were diluted with 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate and treated with 10 mM DTT for 1 h at 56 °C to reduce disulfides and then with 20 mM iodoacetic acid to alkylate the cysteine residues for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Samples were diluted with 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate and treated with 10 mM DTT for 1 h at 56 °C to reduce disulfides and then with 20 mM iodoacetic acid to alkylate the cysteine residues for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Sequencing-grade modified trypsin was provided by Promega.
Then, aliquots of the SIL peptides were added to the protein samples, followed by addition of trypsin at a trypsin-to-protein ratio of 1:50; the reaction mixture was incubated overnight at 37 °C.

collision_energy.evidence: Higher-energy collision dissociation was performed with a stepped-collision energy of 20%, 25%, and 30% with an isolation window of 2.0 Da.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Higher-energy collision dissociation was performed with a stepped-collision energy of 20%, 25%, and 30% with an isolation window of 2.0 Da.

ionization_type.evidence: Samples were analyzed by LC-MS/MS, using a Vanquish HPLC (Thermo Fisher Scientific), coupled in-line with a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) with an ESI source.

labeling.evidence: inferred: The raw LC-MS/MS data files were analyzed using MaxQuant (version 2.6.3.0), with the spectra searched against the UniProt bovine and human proteins (downloaded June 10, 2025); and the proteins encoded on the transfected plasmids.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Samples were analyzed by LC-MS/MS, using a Vanquish HPLC (Thermo Fisher Scientific), coupled in-line with a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) with an ESI source.
